levels.surface: عبد الرحمن بن أبي سعيد الخدري

notes: «قال مر بي عبد الرحمن ... قلت له كيف سمعت أباك» makes Abd al-Rahman the one asked and answering, so he is a link in his own place (rule 6)
the last link is Abd al-Rahman's father, named only as «أبي» (rule 7): his words are the saying
«- لمسجد المدينة -» is a gloss: left out
